title: Code Review Culture
questionDetail: How has your team evolved its code review culture over time? Discuss specific practices, tools, and mindset shifts that have improved both code quality and team collaboration.
answerDetails: Effective code review combines automated checks, pair programming for complex changes, async reviews for simpler ones, and a culture of constructive feedback focused on learning.

title: Architectural Decision Records
questionDetail: How does your team document and communicate architectural decisions? Share your ADR process and how it helps onboard new developers and prevent context loss.
answerDetails: Formal ADR process captures context, options considered, decision rationale, and consequences. Store ADRs in repo, link from code, and review in onboarding.

title: Testing Philosophy Evolution
questionDetail: How has your team's testing philosophy evolved? Discuss the balance between unit, integration, and E2E tests, and how you decide what to test.
answerDetails: Pragmatic test pyramid focuses on high-value unit tests, critical integration points, and key user journey E2E tests. Balance coverage with maintenance cost.

title: CI/CD Pipeline Optimization
questionDetail: What innovations has your team implemented in CI/CD? Share specific improvements that reduced build times, increased reliability, or improved developer experience.
answerDetails: Continuous improvement includes parallelization, caching, flaky test detection, deployment previews, and progressive rollouts. Measure and iterate on pipeline metrics.

title: Technical Debt Management
questionDetail: How does your team identify, track, and pay down technical debt? Describe your process for making debt visible and getting buy-in for addressing it.
answerDetails: Incremental improvement uses debt tracking systems, regular refactoring time, boy scout rule, and clear business impact communication to steadily improve code health.

title: Monitoring and Observability
questionDetail: How has your team evolved its approach to monitoring and observability? Discuss the journey from basic monitoring to comprehensive observability.
answerDetails: Full observability combines structured logging, distributed tracing, metrics, and error tracking. Focus on answering 'why' not just 'what' during incidents.

title: Knowledge Sharing Practices
questionDetail: What practices has your team developed for effective knowledge sharing? Discuss both synchronous and asynchronous methods that work for your team.
answerDetails: Blended approach includes documentation, recorded demos, pair programming, mob sessions, brown bags, and rotation programs. Different knowledge types need different sharing methods.

title: Developer Tool Building
questionDetail: How does your team decide when to build vs buy developer tools? Share examples of internal tools that significantly improved productivity.
answerDetails: Strategic matrix evaluates core competency alignment, total cost, maintenance burden, and differentiation value. Build when it provides competitive advantage.

title: Incident Response Evolution
questionDetail: How has your team's incident response process matured? Discuss changes in tooling, processes, and culture that improved MTTR and learning.
answerDetails: Blameless culture focuses on system improvement not individual fault. Includes clear roles, runbooks, post-mortems, and systematic improvement implementation.

title: Performance Optimization
questionDetail: How does your team approach performance optimization? Share your methodology for identifying bottlenecks and measuring improvement impact.
answerDetails: Proactive culture includes performance budgets, continuous profiling, load testing, and optimization sprints. Measure user impact not just technical metrics.

title: API Design Standards
questionDetail: How has your team developed and evolved API design standards? Discuss the balance between consistency and flexibility in your approach.
answerDetails: Evolving guidelines provide consistency while allowing innovation. Include versioning strategy, error handling, authentication patterns, and documentation requirements.

title: Security Integration
questionDetail: How has your team integrated security into the development workflow? Share specific practices that shifted security left without slowing delivery.
answerDetails: DevSecOps integration includes IDE security plugins, pre-commit hooks, SAST/DAST in CI, dependency scanning, and security champions program.

title: Remote Collaboration
questionDetail: How has your team adapted development practices for remote/hybrid work? Discuss tools, processes, and cultural changes that maintained or improved productivity.
answerDetails: Comprehensive adaptation includes async-first communication, virtual pair programming tools, timezone-aware scheduling, and intentional team building.

title: Microservices Lessons
questionDetail: What lessons has your team learned from microservices adoption? Discuss both successes and challenges in your architectural evolution.
answerDetails: Pragmatic design starts with modular monoliths, extracts services based on scaling needs, team boundaries, and deployment independence. Not everything needs to be a service.

title: Database Evolution
questionDetail: How has your team's approach to data management evolved? Discuss migrations, schema evolution, and polyglot persistence decisions.
answerDetails: Fit-for-purpose approach matches data stores to use cases: RDBMS for transactions, NoSQL for flexibility, cache for performance, search for discovery.

title: Code Ownership Models
questionDetail: How does your team balance code ownership with collective responsibility? Discuss the evolution of your ownership model and its impact.
answerDetails: Collective ownership with recognized expertise encourages collaboration while maintaining quality. Code owners guide but don't gate contributions.

title: Developer Experience Metrics
questionDetail: What metrics does your team track for developer experience? Share how these metrics drive tooling and process improvements.
answerDetails: Comprehensive metrics include build time, test time, deployment frequency, time to first commit, developer NPS, and tooling satisfaction. Drive improvements with data.

title: Innovation Time Results
questionDetail: How does your team's innovation time translate to production improvements? Share examples of hackathon or 20% time projects that became core features.
answerDetails: Integrated innovation includes hackathons, innovation sprints, and exploration stories. Success requires clear paths from prototype to production.

title: Dependency Management
questionDetail: How does your team manage external dependencies? Discuss your approach to updates, security patches, and avoiding dependency hell.
answerDetails: Balanced strategy includes automated security updates, scheduled minor updates, careful major version migrations, and dependency audit tools.

title: Platform Engineering Impact
questionDetail: How has platform engineering improved your team's productivity? Share specific examples of platform capabilities that unlocked developer velocity.
answerDetails: Full platform includes self-service infrastructure, golden paths, developer portals, and automated compliance. Measure impact through developer productivity metrics.
